description:
[Candidates] Show what merging merge_id into keep_id would do: both values of each field, the records that move, blockers, and `preview_token`. merge_candidates needs that token, and refuses it if either candidate changed since.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

keep_id.description: Candidate id (the `id` of a list_candidates row) of the record that stays.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merge_id.description: Candidate id (the `id` of a list_candidates row) of the record merged into it (archived afterwards).

name: preview_candidate_merge
title: Preview merging two candidates
